verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents that it classifies products into categories/subcategories that determine cross-jurisdiction taxability and that tax estimates factor in product taxability, nexus, and exemptions, but there is no visible research trail, citation of state-specific statutes/rulings, or discussion of digital-goods/bundled-offering edge cases showing 'how' determinations were made. missing for 10: visible per-determination research/citations, explicit handling of digital-goods and bundled-product taxability edge cases, independent verification of accuracy on hard cases.
